key_decisions: FABIO'S REVIEW CONVENTION: he names ONLY what he dislikes. Silence means approved. Session 18 recorded seven categories as 'unjudged' when they had already passed, and that cost a whole gate. Never re-ask for a verdict he has already given by not giving one.

AGE DIES AT THE CHATTERBOX TTS STEP, NOT THE VC STEP. Every clip that went through TTS reads 50-65 or 'young men'; no clip that skipped it does. Fabio judged the raw VC results 'useful and usable' as old men. This is why 80-90 is unreachable synthetically and why 60-70 is reachable reliably.

PITCH IS NOT THE AGE CUE - a hypothesis of mine that DIED. Aiming VC at 200/255 Hz targets reproduced the source's pitch almost exactly (211.3 and 216.2 Hz against 215.6) and Fabio's verdict on both was 'young men'. Matching the number changed nothing.

AGE BANDS, set by Fabio 2026-08-26: elderly is 60-90, mature is 40-60. 'Not every elderly man needs to be super elderly.' This re-sorted existing clips rather than discarding them - seed 9003 (~60) became a keeper, seed 9002 (~50) did not.

PERSONAS' per-category register is NOT a defect - another claim of mine that was wrong. ingest.py line 308 derives `register` per voice from the measured f0; the category value is only a prompt-time target that never ships. No schema change needed.

JITTER IS RETIRED AS AN AGE METRIC. It read 2.7-3.4% across Fabio's real 85-year-old, his 75-year-old, and a model clip he called 'sounds 25', and it predicted age wording would fail when his ear then fixed three categories with wording alone.
ALL 12 EMOTION CELLS REMAIN ACCEPTED AND SHIPPED (Phase 2). The kyutai corpus rejection and the 12-category taxonomy are both closed. Do not reopen any of them.

When his ear and a number disagree, the number is wrong until proven otherwise.
